IS IT A FIT?

For a report you already know.

You have a recurring report, reliable exports and someone who can verify the totals. The pilot turns that existing process into a repeatable tool.

Keep the first project focused

The pilot runs on your existing computer. Live integrations, write access, hosting, payroll, medical records and continuous support need a separate scope.

We check your computer setup before quoting. Customer data is shared only after its handling and retention are agreed.

BEFORE YOU ASK

A few practical details.

Do I need another monthly subscription?

The pilot has no recurring service charge. It uses your existing computer and a local script. Any required setup is checked before the quote is accepted.

What if the output does not match the agreed sample?

We correct defects in the agreed scope. The handover includes a 14-day period to report defects; that period does not shorten your statutory rights. Requested new measures or integrations are quoted separately.

Can I send my spreadsheets now?

Start with a short description. Please do not attach production exports, passwords, bank details or personal records to an initial enquiry. We agree data handling before receiving files.

Does asking for a quote commit me to anything?

No. This page accepts enquiries. An order requires a written quote, confirmed delivery slot and agreed terms. There is no checkout or payment collection here.
